notes: A long task description no longer breaks the Dashboard. One long description used to stretch every card on the page far off the right-hand side, including cards whose own descriptions were short.
Descriptions now show two lines and then trail off, instead of one, so there is enough there to recognise a task by. The full text is always in the edit window.

A pasted link or any long stretch of text with no spaces in it could break the layout too, on Timeline as well as the Dashboard. Long unbroken text now wraps instead of forcing the page wider than the window.

Titles are capped at 200 characters and descriptions at 5,000 when you save. Far longer than anything anyone writes, but it keeps a runaway paste from filling up the browser storage the whole app shares. Anything already saved is left as it is.
